candidates.change_summary: Change the final return value from true to false so the function returns false on successful completion.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of always returning true, making the returned value reflect the final call's success.
Return the negation of the success flag of the last low-level call (so a successful last call yields false), making observable return differ.
Change the encoded selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) (swapping parameter order) so external calls target a different signature, altering external behavior.
Change the selector to transferFrom(address,address,uint256) but swap the call arguments order to ( _tos[i], from, v ), changing what gets passed to the external call.
Remove the require(_s) check so failed external calls do not revert, altering observable outcomes when external calls fail.
Change loop to iterate in reverse order (i from _tos.length down to 1) so external calls occur in reverse sequence, affecting observable order-dependent behavior.
